Container.Name: athena
Container.Overview: Athena answers Describe It in Ithaca, the Plex app for Apple TV, iPhone and iPad. You type what you're in the mood for, and Claude picks from your own Plex library, with titles to request when Seerr is connected. Only people with access to your Plex server can use it. Run it next to Plex and Seerr. After installing, open the WebUI, sign in with Plex and add an Anthropic API key. Keep port 8800 so your household's Ithaca finds Athena by itself; friends away from home reach it through your reverse proxy, like Seerr.
Container.Requires: A Plex Media Server and an Anthropic API key. Ithaca for Plex with Ithaca Pro on your devices.

Config.Name: WebUI and API port
Config.Description: Keep 8800: Ithaca looks for Athena on this port on your Plex server's address.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, including your API keys (readable only by Athena), and the request log.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional: set it in the WebUI instead. Set here, it wins and the WebUI shows it locked.

Config.Name: TypeSafe API key
Config.Description: Optional: library picks from Jev. Can be set in the WebUI instead.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional: your Plex server's address, such as http://192.168.1.10:32400. Leave empty to choose the server in the WebUI.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Optional: the Claude model. Can be set in the WebUI instead.
